title: Product Lifecycle New Product Project Manager
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a seasoned New Product Project Manager to lead the introduction and ramp-up of new products from concept through production. Drive programme leadership, multi-functional collaboration, and ensure timely delivery and quality. Ideal for candidates with significant experience in NPI and product lifecycle management.
description:
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

Become part of Cisco's  Product Operation team under Global Supply chain org.

We are seeking a seasoned New Product Project Manager to join our dynamic team, be a part of  New Product Introduction; Product Lifecycle and Cost Management team—a high-impact group dedicated to ensuring the success, profitability, and quality of Cisco's product portfolio from initial launch to end-of-life (EOL).

As a New Product Program Manager (NPPM), you will be responsible for driving the successful introduction and ramp-up of new products  from concept through production. You will partner multi-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to ensure on-time delivery, quality, and cost objectives are met. This role requires strong program management skills, technical competence, and the ability to influence and coordinate across multiple organizations.
 

Your Impact

Program Leadership: Lead multi-functional teams through the full product lifecycle-from Concept, prototyping, and validation through volume production.

Schedule Management: Develop, maintain, and communicate detailed Mfg/Prototype schedules, achievements, and deliverables.

Risk Management: Identify and proactively manage program risks, ensuring timely mitigation plans are in place.

Partner Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for program status, updates, and critical issues to stakeholders and interested parties.

Lifecycle Ownership: Own all aspects of product lifecycle management-scope definition, BOM/POR, schedules, interlocks, communication, and sustaining handoffs.

Multi-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Test, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Marketing to ensure alignment and resolve issues.

Cost and Quality Targets: Ensure products meet established cost, quality, and reliability targets at each development stage.

Program Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives in program execution, using standard methodologies and lessons learned.

 

Minimum Qualifications 

You have 8+ years of experience in New product introduction (NPI) processes and product lifecycle management

Diploma/Bachelor graduate in Engineering or related field

Understanding elements of Product cost including SW.

Proficiency in Electronics/Computer/AI field.

Familiarity with hardware/system design, testing, and production engineering.

Knowledge on HW and SW product lifecycle management.

Demonstrated success in launching at least 6-8 new  products within fast-paced, settings

You are a quick learner who understands the current operational processes, tools/systems, and pain points and who can rally the team to drive changes.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong global program/project management background, including engagement with multiple geographic locations- preferably in EMS/OEM industry

Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to lead and influence multi-functional teams without direct authority.

Good at Presentation and Communication. Excellent communication and follow-up skills, ability to manage multiple tasks, strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Experience using program management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet)

Why Cisco?

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
